articles.title: Bitcoin hits $64K as gold gains while oil shakes off Trump Oman threat
articles.snippet: Bitcoin price strength saw BTC/USD pass $64,000 on 2% daily gains as gold pushed higher while US stocks wobbled on fresh US-Iran rhetoric.

articles.title: Kalshi ordered to stop broad range of prediction markets in Washington
articles.snippet: Kalshi must implement initial geofencing by Aug. 19 and a GeoComply multi-source geofencing system by Sept. 2.

articles.title: Kalshi Ordered to Block Washington Bets Days After CFTC Backed It
articles.snippet: A King County judge gave the exchange until August 19 to stop offering sports, election and politics wagers in the state.
